scope.purpose: bounded operational evidence and feasibility only

pointer_convention: Paths beginning roots.<key>/ are resolved against the named absolute root. Per-candidate metadata filenames and JSON pointers resolve against asset_dir. Adapter and boundary IDs resolve below; these are evidence references, not launch instructions.

release_evidence.lineage: Release exported retained native FP64 costs with solver_runs=0. All 13 candidate complete.json result_sha256 values equal the corresponding release manifest source_costs.results hashes; metadata comparison only, no cost generation or route rescoring.
release_evidence.train_identity: Each release <problem>train/index_mapping.csv maps local_index to source_index; join source generation shards by start_index/count. Each frozen TRAIN has 81000 rows; source label shards cover all 90000 new rows, including later holdouts: never capture entire source shards indiscriminately.

per_candidate_recorded_files.checkpoint_and_config: profile.json (checkpoint/checkpoints, checkpoint_sha256, budget, parameters/model_params/env_params where present)
per_candidate_recorded_files.execution: shards/<id>.json (producer_sources, pid, created_at, chunks offset/count/seed; optional batch_execution)

shared_evidence_contract.producer_snapshots: roots.label_work/labels/source_snapshots/<hash>/<script>; use each shard's recorded producer_sources, not today's default factory/config as historical proof.
shared_evidence_contract.read_boundary: Release/source metadata, 13 locked profiles/contracts/bindings/completions, one TRAIN-source shard schema per candidate, selected final-shard metadata and directly linked source/config only; not a full shard/runtime audit. No VAL/TEST/LIB label files opened.
shared_evidence_contract.trace_status_semantics: unknown means no nonterminal trace asset was identified in this bounded inspection; inspected saved payload schemas contain final costs/tours and audit/execution metadata only. This is not a filesystem-wide proof of absence. Seeds, replay records and final-tour prefixes are not native computation histories.
shared_evidence_contract.adapter_status_semantics: All adapter IDs below exist and match recorded embedded class source or adapter file SHA256. Source-level availability is yes; exact runnable historical runtime is unknown: no imports, dependency smoke, checkpoint loading or execution performed. Checkpoint paths were stat-checked, not rehashed.
shared_evidence_contract.historical_identity: Acceptance and retrospective dependency/lifecycle replays establish recorded baseline compatibility, not original file-byte/runtime identity. Latest linked label metadata is available above; full per-row historical runtime identity remains unknown, not replaced by defaults.
missing_for_all: Persisted stepwise native states/decisions and a recorder bound to instance, stage, augmentation/start and source hashes
Per-row original runtime/RNG/lifecycle attribution beyond inspected metadata; no universal exact-history certification
shared_evidence_contract.r117_exclusion: The header and SPEC of /public/home/shiys/0selection2/code/V4/r117_native.py explicitly describe input-defined reference probes without actions/environments, not visited prefixes or historical cost recipes. Its donor checkpoints are not substituted for these label deployments.
shared_evidence_contract.future_capture_limit: Only a separately authorized finite TRAIN-only observation of the recorded candidate recipe could yield newly realized histories. Preserve recorded budgets, starts, augmentation, selection, RNG and batching; do not regenerate/replace labels, invent a teacher, or start capture automatically.
